question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q2c — Wind Turbine Speed of Air, Input Power, Efficiency
question.text:
The mass of air passing through the circular area swept out by the turbine blades every second is 8.5 kg and its kinetic energy during this time is 2500 J.

(i) Calculate the speed of the air. (3 marks)

(ii) Calculate the input power of the air. (2 marks)

(iii) Calculate the efficiency of the wind turbine, given that the output power of the generator is 1350 W. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Q2c(i) — Speed of air:

KE = ½mv² → v² = 2KE/m = (2 × 2500) / 8.5 = 5000 / 8.5 = 588.24 m² s⁻²

v = √588.24 ≈ 24.25 m s⁻¹ ≈ 24.3 m s⁻¹

Q2c(ii) — Input power:

Power = Energy / time = 2500 J / 1 s = 2500 W

(The KE given is per second, so it is already the power in watts.)

Q2c(iii) — Efficiency:

η = (P_output / P_input) × 100 = (1350 / 2500) × 100 = 54%

steps.label:
